title: WSLProxy — Enterprise SRE Dashboard
description: Google-SRE-style operational dashboard for the WSLProxy platform: golden signals, SLI/SLO, error budgets, multi-window burn rates, backend health, WAF/SSL/cache, troubleshooting and alerting. Generated by monitoring/grafana/generate_dashboard.py.

list.name: datasource
list.label: Data source (Environment)
list.description: Pick the Prometheus for the environment (int / prod) you want to inspect.

panels.title: Global Availability (current)
panels.description: Share of requests not answered with a 5xx over the last 5m. Targets: 99.9 / 99.95 / 99.99 %.

panels.title: Error Budget Remaining (30d)
panels.description: Remaining monthly error budget for the $slo_availability availability SLO.

panels.title: Availability SLO (30d)
panels.description: 30-day availability vs 99.95% target.

panels.title: Latency SLO (30d)
panels.description: Share of requests faster than 500ms over 30d vs 95% target.

panels.title: Backend Success SLO (30d)
panels.description: Backend (origin) success ratio vs 99.9% target.

panels.title: Overall System Health
panels.description: Green ≥99.9% · Yellow ≥99% · Red <99% (5m availability).

panels.title: Failed Backends
panels.description: Backends currently marked unhealthy by the traffic router.

panels.title: Critical Alerts Firing
panels.description: Prometheus ALERTS series with severity=critical.

panels.title: Degraded Services (5xx in last 5m)
panels.description: Domains that served at least one 5xx in the last 5 minutes.

panels.title: Errors — WAF Blocks & Suspicious Requests
panels.description: WAF block / SSL handshake counters populate once the first event is recorded by the exporter.

panels.title: Saturation — CPU & Memory (node_exporter)
panels.description: Requires node_exporter scraped with matching instance labels.

panels.title: Saturation — Network & File Descriptors (node_exporter)
panels.description: Requires node_exporter. FD series shares the axis (count).

panels.title: Availability SLI — non-5xx / total
panels.description: successful_requests / total_requests (5m rolling). 5xx = failure; 499 client aborts are not counted against the SLI.

panels.title: Latency SLI — requests < 500ms / total
panels.description: requests_under_500ms / total_requests using the native le=0.5 bucket.

panels.title: Backend Health SLI — healthy / total backends
panels.description: healthy_backends / total_backends from the traffic router health gauge.

panels.title: Success Rate SLI — 2xx / total
panels.description: Strict success: only 2xx counts (3xx redirects excluded).

panels.title: SSL Success — current vs 99.99%
panels.description: Requires blackbox_exporter HTTPS probes (probe_success). Shows 'No data' until probes are configured.

panels.title: Availability — burn rate (1h)
panels.description: 1 = burning budget exactly at SLO rate; >1 = overspending.

panels.title: SSL — burn rate (1h)
panels.description: Requires blackbox_exporter.

panels.title: Monthly Budget (allowed failed requests)
panels.description: (1 - SLO) × total requests over the trailing 30 days.

panels.title: Predicted Exhaustion (days @ yesterday's burn)
panels.description: Remaining budget ÷ last-24h failure count. >30d = healthy.

panels.title: Error Budget Remaining % — Trend & Forecast
panels.description: Enable a 'Trend' / forecasting transformation, or use Grafana ML forecast on this query, to project the exhaustion date.

panels.title: Fast Burn (5m / 1h)
panels.description: Pages: at burn 14.4 a 30d budget is gone in 2 days.

panels.title: Medium Burn (30m / 6h)
panels.description: Tickets: sustained medium-rate budget spend.

panels.title: Slow Burn (6h / 24h)
panels.description: Trend watch: slow leak that exhausts budget within the month.

panels.title: Burn Rate — All Windows
panels.description: Warning > 2 · Critical > 5 · Emergency > 10

panels.title: Burn Alert Status
panels.description: Red when the 5m burn rate exceeds 5×.

panels.title: Request Duration — P50 / P90 / P95 / P99 / P99.9
Backend Availability
panels.description: Status (1=healthy) · Health% (24h) · p95 response (1h) · req/s (5m, ≈ active load) · seconds since last failure. Source: traffic-router health gauges (the same data backing the admin /system-status page).

panels.title: Unhealthy Backends (now)
panels.description: Backends the router currently routes around (fail-open after 3 consecutive 5xx, or active health-check failures).

panels.title: Backend Health Trend (24h)
panels.description: Set the dashboard range to 24h for the full trend.

panels.title: Backend Flapping Detection (6h)
panels.description: Health-state transitions in 6h. ≥4 transitions = flapping; investigate the origin or the health-check thresholds.

panels.title: CPU Usage
panels.description: Requires node_exporter on the proxy hosts with matching instance labels.

panels.title: Memory Usage
panels.description: Requires node_exporter on the proxy hosts with matching instance labels.

panels.title: Disk Usage (rootfs)
panels.description: Requires node_exporter on the proxy hosts with matching instance labels.

panels.title: Network Throughput
panels.description: Requires node_exporter on the proxy hosts with matching instance labels.

panels.title: TCP Connections (established)
panels.description: Requires node_exporter on the proxy hosts with matching instance labels.

panels.title: Open File Descriptors
panels.description: Requires node_exporter on the proxy hosts with matching instance labels.

panels.title: OpenResty Connections by State (native)
panels.description: Native exporter metric — reading/writing/waiting worker connections. Production currently runs worker_processes=1: a saturated worker is a full outage (see CLAUDE.md §15).

panels.title: Active Sessions (waiting keep-alive)
panels.description: Keep-alive connections held open. Threads/goroutines do not apply to the OpenResty event model.

panels.title: Exporter Internal Errors
panels.description: nginx-lua-prometheus shared-dict errors — non-zero means metrics are being dropped (increase lua_shared_dict prometheus_metrics).

panels.title: Certificate Expiry (days)
panels.description: Requires blackbox_exporter HTTPS probes (module: http_2xx over TLS) against each public domain.

panels.title: Certificates Expiring < 30 days
panels.description: Requires blackbox_exporter HTTPS probes (module: http_2xx over TLS) against each public domain.

panels.title: TLS Probe Failures (now)
panels.description: Requires blackbox_exporter HTTPS probes (module: http_2xx over TLS) against each public domain.

panels.title: SSL Handshakes by Protocol
panels.description: Native counter (nginx_ssl_handshakes_total) — populates once the exporter records the first handshake.

panels.title: SSL-related Log Errors
panels.description: auto-ssl / cert renewal failures surfaced via the log-level counters. Renewal status itself lives in data/ssl/{domain}.json.

panels.title: Blocked Requests (range total)
panels.description: Populates when the WAF records its first block — counter family nginx_waf_blocked_total{host,category,severity} exists in the exporter.

panels.title: Top Attack Categories
panels.description: Populates when the WAF records its first block — counter family nginx_waf_blocked_total{host,category,severity} exists in the exporter.

panels.title: SQL Injection Attempts
panels.description: Populates when the WAF records its first block — counter family nginx_waf_blocked_total{host,category,severity} exists in the exporter.

panels.title: XSS Attempts
panels.description: Populates when the WAF records its first block — counter family nginx_waf_blocked_total{host,category,severity} exists in the exporter.

panels.title: Geo / IP Blocks
panels.description: Country/IP rule blocks (rule match with 403 response).

panels.title: WAF Inspection Latency — p95
panels.description: WAF adds this much latency to every inspected request.

panels.title: Cache Hit Rate
panels.description: hits / (hits + misses) for the static-content cache.

panels.title: Cache Size & Entries
panels.description: Gauge family exists in the exporter; populates when cache size tracking records its first sample.

panels.title: Top Cached Content (hits by domain/type, range)

targets.expr: sort_desc(100 * sum by (host) (increase(nginx_cache_hits_total{instance=~"$instance",host=~"$host"}[$__range])) / clamp_min(sum by (host) (increase(nginx_cache_hits_total{instance=~"$instance",host=~"$host"}[$__range])) + sum by (host) (increase(nginx_cache_misses_total{instance=~"$instance",host=~"$host"}[$__range])), 1))

panels.title: Backend Traffic Distribution (range)
panels.description: Compare against configured wslproxy_traffic_weight_percent.

panels.title: Configured Traffic Weights
panels.description: Weights set via the admin UI / update_traffic_split. Empty until a weighted split is configured.

panels.title: Load Balancing Efficiency (CoV)
panels.description: Coefficient of variation of per-backend request rate. 0 = perfectly even. Expected >0 with intentional weighted splits.

panels.title: Traffic Skew (max / avg)
panels.description: How much hotter the busiest backend runs vs the average.

panels.title: Backend Saturation — p95 response per backend
panels.description: Rising p95 under steady traffic = backend saturating. Bucket ceiling is 2.5s (exporter histogram definition).

panels.title: Auth Failures
panels.description: Includes JWT validation failures — admin API auth is JWT bearer; 401/403 on /api/* ≈ token rejected/expired (1h expiry, no refresh).

panels.title: Node Availability Timeline
panels.description: pop0 = 187.124.112.155 · lon1 = 72.62.211.28 (instance label from the Prometheus scrape config).

panels.title: Failover / Health-transition Events
panels.description: Backend health-state transitions; spikes = failover churn.

panels.title: Failed Requests Explorer (filtered by Route/Status variables)

targets.expr: topk(100, sum by (host, endpoint, method, status) (increase(nginx_http_requests_total{instance=~"$instance",host=~"$host",endpoint=~"$endpoint",status=~"$status_code",status=~"4..|5.."}[$__range])))

panels.description: Filter with the Service, Route and Status Code dashboard variables. Sorted by failure count over the dashboard range.

panels.title: Error Correlation — errors vs latency vs saturation
panels.description: Overlay of error rate, latency, connections and CPU to spot the leading indicator during an incident.

panels.title: Incident Timeline — per-service 5xx state
panels.description: Red segments = the service emitted 5xx in that window. Alert annotations (firing ALERTS) overlay all panels.

panels.title: Oldest Firing Alert (age)
panels.description: How long the longest-running alert has been active.

panels.title: Firing & Pending Alerts
panels.description: Alert Name · Severity · State · affected labels. Active-since timestamps live in ALERTS_FOR_STATE (Explore).
